15.name: Investigate Echo Ridge
desc: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.
objectives: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.
details: $N, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought. A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.
BGo to the mine and remove them. We know there are at least 10. Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
completion: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine. No good can come of this. Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again. I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...

39.name: Deliver Thomas' Report
desc: Report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
objectives: Report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
details: Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.
BI know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.
completion: Hmm, this news is troubling. Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.
BIf things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!

63.name: Call of Water
desc: Defeat the Corrupt Manifestation of Water and place the Corrupted Manifestation's Bracers along with the Remaining Drops of Purest Water on the Brazier of Everfount in Silverpine Forest.
objectives: Defeat the Corrupt Manifestation of Water and place the Corrupted Manifestation's Bracers along with the Remaining Drops of Purest Water on the Brazier of Everfount in Silverpine Forest.
details: Along the coast of Silverpine, west of the Sepulcher, you will find a shrine that has become tainted by the plague. The spirits there no longer speak to our people and it will be up to you to defeat the manifestation and cleanse the pool.
BTake the elemental's bracers, along with the remaining drops of Brine's potion, and place them on the brazier. The ritual should be enough to summon a pure spirit for you to communicate with.
BBring me proof the task is done, and I will reward you with your totem.
completion: You place the bracers atop the brazier and then pour the remaining drops of Brine's potion into the flame. The drops crackle as they hit the flame and you begin to incant the simple words Islen taught you....

87.name: Goldtooth
desc: Bring Bernice's Necklace to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
objectives: Bring Bernice's Necklace to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
details: I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, the old lady's necklace. Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!
BWell anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run into the mine. Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!
completion: Oh, you found it! Thank you, thank you dear!
BHere, take this. It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky. If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! *sniff*

111.name: Speak with Gramma
desc: Speak with Gramma Stonefield.
objectives: Speak with Gramma Stonefield.
details: Please, $N, talk with my Gramma. If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.
BShe's inside our house east of here.
completion: While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.
BHm, what can we do...

135.name: The Defias Brotherhood
desc: Take Wiley's Note to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
objectives: Take Wiley's Note to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
details: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons. Perhaps that was a slip of tongue. Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons? Only one man would know for sure: Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
completion: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.

159.name: Juice Delivery
desc: Bring the Zombie Juice to Abercrombie at his shack.
objectives: Bring the Zombie Juice to Abercrombie at his shack.
details: Here's your Zombie Juice...
B...and be careful with this stuff. It's strong enough to raise the dead!
completion: A thousand thanks, $N. You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness!
BHere you are, friend. Take this as a token of my gratitude.

183.name: The Boar Hunter
desc: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.
objectives: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.
details: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?

BThough, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.
BLong story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
completion: Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. Thank you, $N.

207.name: Kurzen's Mystery
desc: Find the 4 tablets and bring their legends back to Brother Nimetz.
objectives: Find the 4 tablets and bring their legends back to Brother Nimetz.
details: Colonel Kurzen was once a great, noble man - I must find what caused his fall into depravity! He may be under the sway of troll magic. To confirm this, I must study some of their legends.
BThere are 4 tablets hidden within the troll ruins of Stranglethorn. I must see what is written on these tablets! Transcribe their markings and bring the transcriptions back to me.
BThe first tablet is in the Bal'lal Ruins, the second is in the Vile Reef, and the third and fourth are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.
completion: Thank you, $N. I will study these legends to see if there is some link between the trolls and the evil that has possessed Colonel Kurzen.

231.name: A Daughter's Love
desc: Take Sarah Ladimore's ring to Morgan Ladimore's grave.
objectives: Take Sarah Ladimore's ring to Morgan Ladimore's grave.
details: Here, take this and lay it on his grave. Maybe... somehow, he'll know that I'm okay, and that none of us hold him responsible for what happened.
B<There are tears in her eyes now, as she slides a ring from her right hand, and presses it into your hands.>
BAnd... thank you, $n.
completion: <A ghostly voice sounds on the wind...>
BThis is...? Sarah? Could it be she's still alive? The weight is removed from my shoulders...

B$N. Take my sword, Archeus. As my soul is put to rest, I have no more need for it. It was forged to do good, and though I have proved myself unworthy to hold it, perhaps you will carry on the Light through it.
BLys, my love...

255.name: Mercenaries
desc: Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar has hired you to kill 4 Mo'grosh Ogres, 4 Mo'grosh Brutes and 4 Mo'grosh Enforcers.
objectives: Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar has hired you to kill 4 Mo'grosh Ogres, 4 Mo'grosh Brutes and 4 Mo'grosh Enforcers.
details: Two months just to hear from Ironforge that we'll be spared a handful of soldiers for our own defense, and another two months until they arrive! Bad enough that our town goes unprotected, but the excavation and the dam--the dam!--are open to attacks as well.
BI've no choice then, it seems. I'll need hired arms.
BHow about you? You seem a likely sort, $c. A group of ogres has set up camp on the northeast of the lake. Perhaps you will be the one to remove the threat to our town?
completion: Ah, this is excellent news! Your efforts are greatly appreciated by myself and the people of Thelsamar. Better yet, if we can solve the ogre problem, we'll be able to shift our focus to those Light-burning troggs.

279.name: Claws from the Deep
desc: Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs.
Slay Gobbler and take his head.
Bring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.
objectives: Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs.
BSlay Gobbler and take his head.
BBring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.
details: Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline. They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.

BOne of these murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other bluegill murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby murloc hovels. Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.
BGobbler prowls the river inlet north of here. Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.
completion: Ah, well done $N.
BAccept this as payment for fulfillment of your contract with the Merchant Marines.

303.name: The Dark Iron War
desc: Motley Garmason at Dun Modr wants you to kill 10 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Dark Iron Tunnelers, 5 Dark Iron Saboteurs and 5 Dark Iron Demolitionists.
objectives: Motley Garmason at Dun Modr wants you to kill 10 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Dark Iron Tunnelers, 5 Dark Iron Saboteurs and 5 Dark Iron Demolitionists.
details: War rages both home and abroad. While mighty Dwarven soldiers give their lives in far off territories in the name of the Alliance, our own lands fall prey to the evil deeds of the Dark Iron Dwarves. They laid waste to the Thandol Span. Dun Modr fell soon after.
BWe need you to gather force and push the front back. If you can kill 10 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Tunnelers, 5 Saboteurs and 5 Demolitionists, the reserve might arrive in time to finish the drive.
BNow make haste!
completion: You upheld your orders well, $C. You have proven yourself to be a valiant soldier and loyal servant to King Magni and for that I salute you! With the pressure you applied to the Dark Iron encampment, we now stand a chance of driving them off our lands for good. . .if only the damned reserve would show. . . .

351.name: Find OOX-17/TN!
desc: Bring the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot.
objectives: Bring the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot.
details: You have uncovered some sort of strange, egg-shaped device made from metal. Fiddling with one of its knobs springs the egg to life, as it opens up into some sort of gnomish robotic contraption! A voice from inside the robotic egg crackles to life.

B"The name's Oglethorpe, and my homing robot has gone missing! I will reward you for its recovery! Please take this beacon to the robot. Excellent, I now have computed the coordinates for you! It crashed near the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris!"
completion: You place the egg... distress beacon... inside the chicken... homing robot.
BHums and whirs are heard from inside the robot as it struggles to stand up. After the robot comes to life, Oglethorpe's voice is heard once more, but now from inside the robot:
B"OOX-17/TN is working at least, but it needs major repairs! It is much too heavy for you to carry it... but I think I have an idea. Are you up for watching over it some more?"

375.name: The Chill of Death
desc: Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in Brill.
objectives: Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in Brill.
details: It's so cold, now. The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent. The Mindless State will be upon me soon. But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady. When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.
BNow my hands shake from the chill. If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket. Help me, $N, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
completion: I appreciate your efforts, $N. May Slyvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .

399.name: Humble Beginnings
desc: Go to Baros Alexston's house in Westfall and search for his compass, then return it to him in Cathedral Square of Stormwind.
objectives: Go to Baros Alexston's house in Westfall and search for his compass, then return it to him in Cathedral Square of Stormwind.
details: It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.
BI have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.
BYou'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
completion: Oh, thank you, $N! It's of no practical use to me, but the sentimental value... Needless to say, thank you for bringing this to me... at some cost to your own well-being, not to mention the time it took to go all the way down to Westfall. You have my gratitude, and have this as a token of my thanks.

423.name: Arugal's Folly
desc: Bring 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
objectives: Bring 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
details: After examining Arugal's work my worst suspicions were confirmed. The old hack was not qualified to clean chamber pots in Dalaran let alone represent the Kirin Tor in its most dire hour. Fools!

BArugal used enchanted items to reinforce his weak magic. I need to examine these items first hand. Travel forth and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have collected enough of their enchanted shackles for my research. The foul creatures have been seen to the north and east.
completion: I hope I can acquire enough energy from such a limited sample. Perhaps I should have had you get more shackles.
BNonetheless, you showed great skill in collecting these, $C.

447.name: A Recipe For Death
desc: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
objectives: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
details: Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

BMy studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.
completion: How good of Apothecary Renferrel to send you to me, $N. These samples will indeed prove useful to the cause. I will begin studying their toxic and contaminable properties at once.

471.name: Apprentice's Duties
desc: Collect 6 Giant Crocolisk Skins and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
objectives: Collect 6 Giant Crocolisk Skins and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
details: I sent my apprentice out into the marshes to skin some of our famous giant Wetlands crocolisks. When he didn't return, I went out to look for him... Let's just say it wasn't a pretty sight.
BMidwife says he might pull through, but in the meantime I still need my skins!
B...If you'd like to kill a few more of the brutes, I wouldn't be opposed, after what they did. You'll find the crocs north up the coast, beyond the murloc hovels.
completion: Hmm... Don't suppose you'd be interested in becoming my apprentice, would you?

BHah! No, I'm just kidding. You're much too old, for one thing. Besides - from the looks of you, it would seem that you have other ambitions in life. Nonetheless, these are some fine skins you've procured, and I'll be able to put them to good use.

495.name: The Crown of Will
desc: Report to Melisara at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
objectives: Report to Melisara at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
details: Mug'Thol and his ogre warband was sent to Alterac to retrieve the Crown of Will for Lady Sylvanas. Unfortunately, instead of returning it, the idiot decided to try it on... I suppose ogres can't resist anything bright and shiny.
BHis bumbling actions have become something of a problem, however. The Crown of Will enabled him to resist the possession placed upon him to serve Lady Sylvanas.
BThe Dark Lady wants an example made, travel to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad and report to Melisara, my lieutenant.
completion: You were sent by Shalindra? Very well then, you'll find I don't waste much time with idle chatter.
BMug'Thol is an irritant, and we will deal with him quickly, thoroughly, and without incident.

519.name: The Crown of Will
desc: Kill Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Kill Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
details: Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus are Mug'Thol's lieutenants. They are loyal to him, though who can say what drives an ogre to loyalty.
BBring me their heads, $n, and then all that will remain is to remove Mug'Thol's head, crown and all.
completion: ...and I thought ogres smelled foul enough to begin with.
BWhen you bring me Mug'Thol's head, I will have the four of them mounted on pikes above Alterac. A fitting monument to those who go against the Dark Lady's wishes.

543.name: The Perenolde Tiara
desc: Bring the Perenolde Tiara to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring the Perenolde Tiara to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.
details: The Perenolde Tiara is an old heirloom of the Perenolde "nobles" - the ruling family of Alterac before that kingdom fell to ruin. It is said to have been crafted by master jewelers in Ironforge, and fitted with the finest of emeralds.
BWhen Alterac was destroyed the Tiara was lost, but there are rumors that an Ogre Mage, Grel'borg the Miser, found the tiara and now wanders the Ruins of Alterac searching for more treasures.
BWe would have you acquire the tiara for us.
completion: Ah, this is splendid. This will have to be cleaned of course, but you really outdid yourself, $N. I will have someone prepare the tiara and place it within our collection posthaste.

567.name: Dangerous!
desc: High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.
objectives: High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.
details: Dangerous!
BThe following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:
BClerk Horrace Whitesteed. Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.
BCitizen Wilkes. Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.
BMiner Hackett. Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.
BFarmer Kalaba. Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the Undercity.
BAll of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find. A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.
completion: You are quite the bounty hunter, $C. Well done.

591.name: The Mind's Eye
desc: Bring the Mind's Eye to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
objectives: Bring the Mind's Eye to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
details: The Mind's Eye is held by an ogre mage, east of here and deep within the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound. His name is Mai'Zoth. I know him from when the Darkspears dwelt in Stranglethorn - he is vicious, and his magic is strong.
BAnd if he has the Mind's Eye, then his magic will be stronger still.
BYou must face Mai'Zoth and wrest from him the Mind's Eye. It is a perilous task, but it is the only hope we have of saving Yenniku.
completion: You retrieved the eye! Your might is the stuff of legends, $N!
BAnd in getting the Eye, you must have defeated Mai'Zoth and sent him to the Nether. That is why the spirits would not mention him before.
BIt is good that he is gone from the world of flesh and bone, but now that he is in the realm of spirits...I fear he will begin a new reign.
BBut that is a worry for another time. Now, I must perform a ritual to bend the Mind's Eye to our needs...

615.name: The Captain's Cutlass
desc: Speak with Sprogger.
objectives: Speak with Sprogger.
details: After I lost my first ship to those giants, I bought another. Named Smotts' Revenge, I filled it with supplies and crew, and set out to find the villains. I found them, but...they beat me. They smashed Smotts' Revenge, killed my second crew and set me on another lifeboat.
BThis time another of the giants, Negolash, stole my cutlass.
BFace Negolash and bring me my cutlass!
BSpeak with Sprogger. He was my cook on the Smotts' Revenge, and survived the last attack. He can help you find the giant.
completion: Hello hello, $N. Captain told me you're going after Negolash, eh?

639.name: Sigil of Strom
desc: Get the Sigil of Strom for Zengu in Hammerfall.
objectives: Get the Sigil of Strom for Zengu in Hammerfall.
details: In ancient times, trolls fought against the Arathorian Empire and our most capable adversary, Lord Ignaeus of Strom, named Trollbane. He rode into battle wielding Trol'kalar--troll slayer, in their ancient tongue.
BBut now the sons of Trollbane are weakened, their stronghold brought to ruin.
BThe sword is protected by several sigils that were divided among the survivors of Stromgarde, and we must retrieve them.
BThe first was taken by the Syndicate, one of their men in Stromgarde should have it.
completion: Excellent, mon. That's a good start to collecting the sigils we'll need to remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb.

663.name: Land Ho!
desc: Talk to Captain O'Breen in Faldir's Cove.
objectives: Talk to Captain O'Breen in Faldir's Cove.
details: Lolo sees a tiny $r! Always on the lookout, Lolo is!
BWelcome to Faldir's Cove. Captain O'Breen said we'd only be here for a few hours. Just long enough to gather the treasure and get back to Booty Bay.
BBut Lolo thinks we're going to be here a lot longer than that. We lost the other two ships from our formation. Poor Spirit of Silverpine and Maiden's Folly. On the bottom of the sea they rest now!
BLolo suggests you talk to Captain O'Breen if you plan on sticking around here.
completion: Ahoy, matey.
B'Twas a horrible mess. Seahorn will have my ship if he finds out what went down.
BOne of the Professor's contraptions indicated the lost treasure was near this cove. I brought the Harbinger in to dock and signaled for the Spirit of Silverpine and Maiden's Folly to follow suit.
BThen the sea rumbled. The tides lowered and the two ships crashed into the reef.
BIt's not just a reef. Something's down there....
BHelp my crew out and you'll be rewarded handsomely.

687.name: Theldurin the Lost
desc: Find Theldurin the Lost.
objectives: Find Theldurin the Lost.
details: Theldurin the Lost was once a member of our order, the Twilight's Hammer. But he lost his mind and scorned our teachings. And before he fled from us, he stole the scroll of Myzrael! We could not catch him, but rumors say he hides in the Badlands, gibbering and mad.
BTo bring the Lady back to us, you must find the scroll. And to do that, you must find Theldurin.
completion: Hello. Hello, hello hello hello hello HELLO!
BI'm sorry - wait, no I'm not! Don't be rude!
BOh no...that was crazy talk.
BBut...sometimes being crazy is my only solace.

711.name: Study of the Elements: Rock
desc: Bring 3 Large Stone Slabs to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
objectives: Bring 3 Large Stone Slabs to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
details: $N, you've already proven more able than all my apprentices combined.

BThe next parts I need require a little more strength. Large stone slabs can be found on rock elementals if you're careful enough. Their bodies are stronger and larger, and therefore more prone to having pieces large enough for my tests. You can find them further west of here or southeast along the mountains' edges.
BTake your time; I'll need a while to test these smaller pieces you brought me.
completion: $N, simply amazing! I would have thought it'd take half a dozen tauren to bring all these to me.

735.name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart
desc: Return the items on the Bonegrip's Note to Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge.
objectives: Return the items on the Bonegrip's Note to Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge.
details: Yagyin's Digest, eh? Are you starting a new chapter of us, somewhere? Never mind, it is not my place to ask.
BI will help you, for I have an extra copy. We must aid each other, yes? That is how we flourish.
BI require three items of power. Bring them to me and I will give you the digest.
BI will not speak their names. Ears may be on us. But here, I will write them down.
completion: You are resourceful, $C. If it truly is your charge to begin a new chapter of our order, then I believe you will run it well.

759.name: Wildmane Totem
desc: Bring 8 Prairie Alpha Teeth to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
objectives: Bring 8 Prairie Alpha Teeth to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
details: There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan. For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha. Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished.
BAlphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, Thunder Bluff.
completion: Very good, $N. I can feel the sacrifice of the land in this offering, and my spirit swells with sadness, and pride.

783.name: A Threat Within
desc: Speak with Marshal McBride.
objectives: Speak with Marshal McBride.
details: I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young $c, because there is work to do here in Northshire.
BAnd I don't mean farming.

BThe Stormwind guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close. And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home. And their alliance.
BIf you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride. He's inside the abbey behind me.
completion: Ah, good. Another volunteer. We're getting a lot of you these days.
BI hope it's enough.
BThe human lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad. This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.
BIt is a many-fronted battle we wage, $N. Gird yourself for a long campaign.

831.name: The Admiral's Orders
desc: Deliver Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Nazgrel in Thrall's chamber in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Deliver Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Nazgrel in Thrall's chamber in Orgrimmar.
details: Humans cannot be trusted. We fought alongside them with a weary heart, knowing they would betray us one day.
BAdmiral Proudmoore's death was not enough to stop his legacy of deceit. The human scum had his plans well laid out before he ever met his demise.
BHis reign won't even die with Benedict it seems. Who knows how long it will be before the next waves of Proudmoore's men land upon our shores.
BWe need to get these orders to Nazgrel in Orgrimmar immediately! He can be found in Thrall's chamber.
completion: Countless times I urged the Warchief not to trust the humans, but personal pride is not what is at stake here.
BYou have served the Horde honorably, young $C.
BNow excuse me, I must counsel Thrall on these matters at once...

855.name: Centaur Bracers
desc: Bring 15 Centaur Bracers to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
objectives: Bring 15 Centaur Bracers to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
details: The Kolkar are a threat to the Horde's claims in the Barrens; we must reduce the numbers of their troops. And so, I have a bounty task for you.
BWhile in Kolkar territories, slay their warriors and collect centaur bracers. Return when you have a heap of bracers and the Horde will reward you well.
completion: Nicely done. I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, $N. If they have sense, they'll now calm themselves and stop their advances.
BBut I don't think they will, and that is unfortunate.
BUnfortunate...for them.

879.name: Betrayal from Within
desc: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
objectives: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
details: Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, $r. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort>

BNak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a warrior. Kill them, $r, like they have killed me.
completion: It is done then. Better it ends this way, says Mangletooth. <snort> They should have <snort> made sure I was dead when they turned their backs on me instead of leaving <snort> me here in this forsaken cage.
BThere is but one task left for you to finish, $R.

903.name: Prowlers of the Barrens
desc: Collect 7 Prowler Claws from Savannah Prowlers for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
objectives: Collect 7 Prowler Claws from Savannah Prowlers for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
details: Now it's time to go after something that really bites. The prowlers of the Barrens are a tough breed. Tough, resourceful, sly... and deadly. You'll find them among the tall grasses. You'll find many to the southwest of the Crossroads.
BBe wary as you hunt them, $n, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.
completion: Ah, I see you've been busy, lurking in the grasses and hunting prowlers. Do you think, then, it is time to face a champion among them?

927.name: The Moss-twined Heart
desc: Bring the Moss-twined Heart to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
objectives: Bring the Moss-twined Heart to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
details: The heart of Blackmoss the Fetid is covered with a dark, oily moss. In fact, the only way to tell this is a heart is from its slow, rhythmic beat... A beat that continues even now.
BPerhaps Denalan will want to see this heart.
completion: ...What is this? A timberling heart?? It's covered with a foul moss!
BThank you for bringing this to me, $N. I will examine the heart and, if fortune shines, determine the nature of the moss about it.

951.name: Mathystra Relics
desc: Bring 6 Mathystra Relics to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.
objectives: Bring 6 Mathystra Relics to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.
details: The parchment you found at the Master's Glaive is a page from an ancient text...written by elves! It is heavily cursed and tainted by the corruption of the Twilight's Hammer, but it seems the cult is using ancient elven magic to bring their old masters back to our world.

BTravel to the ruins of Mathystra to the northeast, and search for ancient relics among the grass and broken stones. Through their study, we may divine how the Twilight's Hammer intends to exploit the magic of the elves.
completion: Thank you. These relics are from a time when Mathystra shone. That once great bastion of the elves has faded, but shards of its magic remain. Let us hope we can unlock the secrets of that place before our enemies...
BBe vigilant, $N.

975.name: Cache of Mau'ari
desc: Speak to Witch Doctor Mau'ari again in a moment to receive the lucky charm.
objectives: Speak to Witch Doctor Mau'ari again in a moment to receive the lucky charm.
details: Now, before I give ya dis charm, I better explain how ta use it.
BIf you carry da charm with ya, you'll find dat certain items will drop from creatures ya fight. If you don't have da charm with you, you won't find them. Understand?
BYou'll know these special items by the name -- they be called E'ko. If you find any of these items, just bring dem to ol' Mau'ari, and she help ya out.
BWait here while I fix your charm.
completion: Here it is, $N. Remember, ya have ta carry it with you. Why don't ya head back to Winterspring, an' see what ya be findin' there?

1023.name: Raene's Cleansing
desc: Find the Glowing Gem and return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar with Teronis' Journal.
objectives: Find the Glowing Gem and return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar with Teronis' Journal.
details: As you rummage through Teronis' belongings, you find a journal that is still in good condition.
BYou take the journal and leave Teronis' corpse as is.
BThe only thing left to do is find the gem Teronis was seeking. Raene mentioned it being in the area. Perhaps the murlocs have it...
completion: This is terrible, $N. Teronis is dead?!
BThe time for mourning will come, but for now we must focus our efforts. I shall send some of the Sentinels to recover Teronis' body as soon as possible.
BYou have Teronis' journal and the gem he was seeking. Do you think you're capable of completing his task? I would rest much better knowing his death was not in vain.

1047.name: The New Frontier
desc: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
details: Attention, heroes!

BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch Druid in Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
completion: What makes you think I wish to be pestered by the likes of you, $C? Wait - let me stop the important duties I attend to on a daily basis so I can help you locate a doodad somewhere. By all means, the welfare of Darnassus - nay, all of Teldrassil - should come second to the acquisition of a bauble for your collection.
BThe fools in Moonglade waste my time with their call for assistance, and now I must endure this?

1071.name: A Gnome's Respite
desc: Kill 10 Venture Co. Loggers, and 10 Venture Co. Deforesters and return to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.
objectives: Kill 10 Venture Co. Loggers, and 10 Venture Co. Deforesters and return to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.
details: You see, $N, I'm a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, and it's my goal... nay, my DUTY! to show the night elves that a blend of magic, mixtures, and mechanisms can help save their forests.
BBut it's a hard fought war, and the goblins reproduce like rabbits it seems. I haven't even had time to build my newest inventions!
BI need some time to plan and organize. But to do that, I need your help keeping the goblins at bay in Windshear Crag to the east...
completion: Thanks so much for your help, $N. You're actually back just in time.
BI think I've got the perfect plan. Explosives. No, that's not the plan, but it's part of the plan.

BSee, I've been using high explosives--don't worry, they're not as dangerous as everyone thinks--to scare the goblins back a bit. I can herd 'em pretty good with a few key detonations along the mountains' edges, but I've been low on supplies now for a few days.

1095.name: Further Instructions
desc: Bring the new orders to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
objectives: Bring the new orders to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
details: The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.

BRiddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.
BWhatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
completion: Eliminate Gerenzo? Now there is a prospect that I have no objections to.

BGnomes are bad enough as it is, but what I learned about Gerenzo only makes it worse. Apparently, he was one of the head engineers in Gnomeregan, where he was working on their secret project--we could never infiltrate Dun Morogh well enough to find out specific details. It was a failure. Our reports say that whatever it was literally exploded in their faces.

1119.name: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout
desc: Bring the Fool's Stout back to Kravel in the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Bring the Fool's Stout back to Kravel in the Shimmering Flats.
details: I figured out how to use Zanzil's mixture with stout to make a powerful libation. A Fool's Stout. I think it'll be just what Kravel needs, but try it out and let me know how it works.
BAnd $N, don't keep this stuff too long without using it. Zanzil's mixture has a weird effect on the stout's yeast, kicking it into high gear. So it won't stay fresh forever.
completion: Wonderful! Fizzlebub came through! I'll remember that next time I see him.
BAnd thank you, $N. You're doing a great job, and we both stand to make a lot of money from this...

1143.name: The Tower of Althalaxx
desc: Kill Athrikus Narassin and bring his head to Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
objectives: Kill Athrikus Narassin and bring his head to Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
details: I see. Well, if what you say is true, then now is the time to strike. I believe Athrikus resides at the top of the tower. Be careful though, he is surrounded by many powerful warlocks, much more deadly than the ones you faced before.
completion: With the death of Athrikus, I hope that the demonic forces in this area will be driven back. I have no doubt that they will regroup and return, but then we shall be even more prepared to meet their threat.

1167.name: The Tower of Althalaxx
desc: Speak with Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
objectives: Speak with Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
details: Before confronting Athrikus, it would probably be wise for you to consult with Balthule. I have no doubt he has been vigilant in his watch of the Tower, and he may have information about recent developments.
completion: Ah, it's good to see you again, $N! The strangest things have been happening around here, I'm glad you showed up!

BIt was very strange, $N. Everything seemed normal--well, as normal as things get around here--and then suddenly there was a blinding flash of light from the upper room of the tower. Then came the screams. The cries split the air, and lightning struck the ground from time to time. What's going on?

1239.name: The Severed Head
desc: Bring the Defiant Orc Head to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
objectives: Bring the Defiant Orc Head to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
details: Vigorous digging reveals the head of a male orc, raggedly severed at the neck. His lips are frozen in a snarl, and its dark eyes stare defiantly.
completion: This is the head of Marg Nighteye! As I feared, he is dead.
BLook at the wound on his neck! Could a weapon have made that ragged cut, or did some beast slay our agent?
BThis is a mystery we must solve, $N. We must discover if Marg's death was at the hands of the Alliance!

1287.name: The Deserters
desc: Speak with Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore about Reethe.
objectives: Speak with Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore about Reethe.
details: Reethe? That coward?
BWe threw him out of camp because he insisted on raiding the supplies of the ogres up at Brackenwall Village. We're not so many in number that we could stand up to those mindless brutes.
BHe crossed the line one too many times, so we left him to fend for himself.
BNow, I helped you out... So, why don't you help us out and forget you bumped into us?
completion: I will send Lieutenant Caldwell to deal with the deserters at Lost Point. In addition, I will instruct him to find Reethe. The marsh is not so big and trackless that he should be unable to find him.

1359.name: Zinge's Delivery
desc: Bring the Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
objectives: Bring the Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
details: The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens. There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!
BIt's quite incredible, and we must study it further. I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired. Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge. You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.
completion: Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke. I am eager to experiment with these... it is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.

1383.name: Nothing But The Truth
desc: Apothecary Faustin at Beggar's Haunt needs 5 Shadow Panther Hearts, Mire Lord Fungus and a Deep Strider Tumor.
objectives: Apothecary Faustin at Beggar's Haunt needs 5 Shadow Panther Hearts, Mire Lord Fungus and a Deep Strider Tumor.
details: I have just the right serum in mind. It will deal with the truth in precisely the way the truth should be dealt with.

BFor this concoction I will need several Shadow Panther hearts from the Swamp. I also require the enchanted fungus off of the Mire Lord who resides there. I am sure one as able as you, $n, can persuade him to part with some.
BNow the hard part will be locating a Deepstrider tumor from far-off Desolace. Very rarely the giants there become ill and a tumor forms.
BNow, off you go!
completion: Splendid, $N! And just in time too. From what Zraedus tells me, the Infiltrator has recovered from his wounds and is ready to be questioned by the orcs.
BGive me but a moment to prepare the pois - I mean prepare the truth serum.

1431.name: Alliance Relations
desc: Speak to Keldran in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak to Keldran in Orgrimmar.
details: Be still, $c, and allow me to share with you something important to our people, but far from obvious.

BWe are a proud race, and the war with the humans tried even Thrall's great patience. You see, our Warchief is wise and prudent, and he continues to put his people first. Ultimately, he is a diplomat, and in his time with the humans he learned much of their ways.
BIf the tale I've started piques your interest, then find Keldran near the western exit of the city. His hovel is there.
completion: $N, noble $C. I am Keldran, student of magic... and other mystical arts.
BThe business Craven sent you here to speak to me about requires a touch more subtlety than you've previously needed, but that does not mean you can not still aid our cause.
BPlease, make yourself comfortable, and I shall tell you why the Warchief has need of my aid... and yours.
BIt starts with appearances, $N. How the Horde sees itself. How our allies see us. And most importantly, how our enemies see us.

1455.name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
desc: Return to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
objectives: Return to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
details: You take a few moments to figure out what pried the chest open, and you notice along the sides and top of the chest, long, deep scratches that reveal that something other than a man or giant took interest in it. The marks don't appear as if they were caused by dagger or sword.
BAfter going through the chest you find it to be completely empty.
BNot having another course of action, you close the chest and prepare to leave. Kreldig will be disappointed.
completion: Welcome back to Nijel's Point, $N. So, tell me what you found.
BWhat!? Nothing? An empty chest ain't gonna get us paid, I'm afraid.
BTell me more about these marks you saw... these slashes.

1479.name: The Bough of the Eternals
desc: Take the orphan to the bank of Darnassus. The bank itself is hollowed out of a tree known as the Bough of the Eternals.
objectives: Take the orphan to the bank of Darnassus. The bank itself is hollowed out of a tree known as the Bough of the Eternals.
details: I've heard stories about how the night elves have their bank in a tree - one that looks like a bear! That's so cool! Night elves are neat how they like nature and stuff, but bears are just totally awesome!
BWould you take me to see the bear-tree in Darnassus, please? There's a boat that will take us close to there, and it shouldn't take very long. Please, please, please!
completion: Wow, it was cooler than I even imagined - the Bough of the Eternals! I didn't think it'd be so big, but it was! Did you see the bird on top of it too?! I wonder how they got the branches to look like that!
BThanks for taking me to Darnassus, $N. You're awesome!

1503.name: Forged Steel
desc: Bring the Forged Steel Bars to Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
objectives: Bring the Forged Steel Bars to Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
details: I will give you a weapon, $N, but first you must aid me. The Razormanes to the northwest came into my camp a few nights past. They would not meet me in combat, but they know my eyes are bad--a few distracted me with snorts while others stole from me! The cowards!
BThey took an iron chest, and within it were some forged steel bars. If you can recover them then I will give you the weapon you seek.
BSearch for the iron box within the quilboar camps, and return with the forged steel bars.
completion: You found them! And all the bars are here, which doesn't surprise me. I didn't think the Razormanes would know what to do with fine steel like this.
BThank you, $N. Here is your reward. May it serve you well.

1527.name: Call of Fire
desc: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
objectives: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
details: Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Durotar. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.
BYou start off down the path back to the Barrens in search of Kranal Fiss.
completion: Your spirit burns brighter than any torch I've ever seen, $N, and for that, you should be proud.

BIf you continue down this path, the elements will be yours to command, and our brethren will look to you for guidance and wisdom. Let me be the first to congratulate you and present to you your newest totem.

1599.name: Beginnings
desc: Bring 3 Feather Charms to Alamar Grimm in Anvilmar.
objectives: Bring 3 Feather Charms to Alamar Grimm in Anvilmar.
details: You must be the new warlock everyone's been whispering about. Must be someone's taken a liking to you if they've asked me to take time away from my research to start your training.
BDon't worry, I won't hold it against you.
BThe simplest of the summoning spells you will learn is that of the imp. Before I impart this to you, however, you must prove that you have the necessary magical and physical ability.
BBring me three feather charms from the frostmane novices from the cave to the southwest.
completion: Very good, very good! You've done well, $n. Perhaps the interest that is being shown in you is deserved, after all.
BThat'll be for the others to decide--assuming your imp doesn't overpower you and nip your career in the bud. For now, I'm satisfied that you'll probably survive your first few months as a warlock.
BA word about the imp, $n. As a gnome knows, don't let its size fool you, its magic can be very dangerous.

1647.name: The Tome of Divinity
desc: Search the outer ring of Ironforge for John Turner.
objectives: Search the outer ring of Ironforge for John Turner.
details: Your task then, $N, is to find someone here in Ironforge that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.

BDo this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light. I will remain here in the temple for your return. Other paladins will need my guidance also.
completion: THE ORPHANAGE OF STOR... oh, sorry, didn't mean to shout at you, sir.
BMy name is John Turner. How are you?

BGood, good, glad to hear things go well for you. I've had a long day of work already, and I miss my wife terribly, but that's the price you have to pay when there are mouths to feed and backs to clothe.

1719.name: The Affray
desc: Kill Big Will, then speak to Klannoc Macleod on Fray Island.
objectives: Kill Big Will, then speak to Klannoc Macleod on Fray Island.
details: If you want to learn from me, then you must first pass The Affray. It is a challenge we on Fray Island like to offer rising warriors who think they're tough, and if you can pass this test then I'll know you are.
BTo begin, walk into the middle of that crowd yonder and step on the grate. That'll tell Twiggy Flathead you're ready, and he'll send challengers against you.
BBeat all the challengers and he'll call out Big Will. Kill Big Will, and return to me in the time we allow.
completion: Well done, $N. You have passed The Affray!
BYou are a worthy warrior, and I am honored to teach you...

1791.name: The Windwatcher
desc: Speak with Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
objectives: Speak with Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
details: Now that you've learned your berserker's stance, you'll want a nice weapon to use it with.
BTalk to Bath'rah the Windwatcher, a troll hermit who lives between the Alterac Mountains and the Western Plaguelands. He is a skilled weapon maker and a powerful shaman.
BTo find Bath'rah, go to the river that flows along Tarren Mill's eastern flank. Follow it north--Bath'rah is camped near ruins that rest along the river's eastern bank.
completion: You have traveled far, young warrior. I see fire in your eyes. You seek a weapon of great power, yes?
BI can help you with your quest. And you can help me with mine.

1839.name: Ula'elek and the Brutal Gauntlets
desc: Speak with Ula'elek in Durotar.
objectives: Speak with Ula'elek in Durotar.
details: The troll smith Ula'elek will craft for you the brutal gauntlets. He dwells in Durotar, in Sen'jin Village with his Darkspear brethren, and he awaits your coming.
completion: Greetings, $n. Old Thun'grim sent word to me of your coming, but had he kept silent your presence here would not have surprised me.
BThe spirits follow your progress, young warrior, and they tell me that many foes have fallen before you.

1959.name: Report to Anastasia
desc: Speak with Anastasia Hartwell.
objectives: Speak with Anastasia Hartwell.
details: The mages of the Undercity have noted a magical disturbance within the city, and have sent word for mages of the Horde to investigate.
BAnastasia Hartwell can tell you more. Speak with her in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.
completion: It is true. A magical disturbance has been detected in our city. We are not yet sure of its origin, or whether it is malign or benign. We must first gather more information...
BAnd that, $N, brings us to your task.

2199.name: Lore for a Price
desc: Bring five silver bars to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring five silver bars to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
details: I am a jeweler of great renown here in Ironforge! Well, former renown anyway... I have fallen onto hard times due to the chicanery of a competitor! A bad reputation in this business spells financial disaster. As a result, I find myself without a copper to my good-though-currently-sullied name.
BI want you to get me five silver bars to finish an order I received - the first in what seems like an eternity.
BYou get me those five silver bars, and I'll answer your questions on the necklace.
completion: You're all right in my book; I don't care what everyone else has been saying... I kid, I kid! Seriously, thank you my friend.

BNow, the necklace you have is one of my finest creations, but it is missing three gems that help bind magic power to it. I crafted it for a paladin some time ago. He was on a self-appointed quest to clear out the "evil taint" present at an excavation site in the Badlands called Uldaman.
BWell... that paladin died in Uldaman, and that was just the beginning of my woes.

2439.name: The Platinum Discs
desc: Take your reward voucher to Dinita Stonemantle in the Vault of Ironforge.
objectives: Take your reward voucher to Dinita Stonemantle in the Vault of Ironforge.
details: This object is an incredible find. The ancient Titans, or the Creators as these discs refer to them as, are the link to our enchanted creation, if the lore stored in here is correct! We'll need to invest as much research time into this as possible.
BAs for you, heroic $c, take this voucher to Dinita Stonemantle at the vault. It grants you what I think is a fitting for such a tremendous find!
BReturn to me directly when you are ready; there is much more to do for the Explorers' League!
completion: As yes, a voucher from the Explorers' League... and quite the valuable one, might I add.

BThe Explorers' League lends me the authority to offer you a choice in your compensation directly from their vault. You are to receive this item, and you may choose between five superior healing potions or five greater mana potions as your reward.

2583.name: A Boar's Vitality
desc: Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one Basilisk Brain to Bloodmage Drazial.
objectives: Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one Basilisk Brain to Bloodmage Drazial.$B
details: Within these blasted lands exists two species of boar: the ash-mane boar and the helboar.
BIt would appear that the stamina of these beasts renders them nearly immune to harm, as the other animals find them too difficult to kill and consequently, not worth the effort.

BWe need to perform further analysis, $N. Should you bring me three blasted boar lungs, two scorpok pincers, and one basilisk brain, I shall create a divine elixir from the residue of the assay. You will be my first test subject!
completion: The spirit of the boar illuminates your being, $N! I wonder, do you believe yourself to be as invulnerable as these beasts?

2607.name: The Touch of Zanzil
desc: Speak with Doc Mixilpixil in the cellar of the Barracks.
objectives: Speak with Doc Mixilpixil in the cellar of the Barracks.
details: It appears as if you've brought back more information than even I expected. This certainly is a strange turn of events, $N.
BA cure? Hrm... Go down to the cellar and speak with Doc Mixilpixil - he may be able to help.
completion: It's about time! Just put the cheese on the table and skedaddle. Osborne will pay you on the way out.

2751.name: Barbaric Battlements
desc: Bring two Patterned Bronze Bracers, two Bronze Greatswords, and two Sharp Claws to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring two Patterned Bronze Bracers, two Bronze Greatswords, and two Sharp Claws to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.$B
details: Twenty generations of Omosh have held this hammer, $N. A hundred thousand tons of metal we have molded. Tragically, it all ends at Orokk, failure of the Omosh: Without kin and incapable of producing offspring.
BI cannot let the secret recipes of Omosh die with me! Someone must continue the legacy, Omosh or not!
BProve to Orokk you are capable, $N. Bring for Orokk the following: Two patterned bronze bracers, two bronze greatswords, and two sharp claws. Bring them for Orokk and we shall continue.
completion: The bloodline will fade but perhaps the legend of Omosh will continue!
BYou have proven that you are a blacksmith, $N. For the blacksmith the reward is the satisfaction of seeing their weapons and armors coated in the blood of their enemies!
BMay the breastplates you create for the generations ahead be drenched in the blood of your enemies!

2847.name: Wild Leather Armor
desc: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: $n, you're becoming quite skilled as a leatherworker! I know some patterns you might be interested in... Wild Leather armor! Wild Leather taps into the potent and chaotic properties of wildvines, found in areas of lush vegetation and on some of the creatures there. The armor made using it is second to none for people of your skill, guaranteed.
BI'll teach this to you, but you'll be working for me for a while. The first cost is simply ten pieces of thick leather. After this, we'll talk specifics.
completion: Well $N, I'm glad to have you on board. You've made a smart decision as a leatherworker; those who wear leather armor will be clamoring to you once you learn how to make any of the Wild Leather armor pieces.
BLet's get to work - where do you want to start?

2871.name: Delivering the Relic
desc: Deliver the Mysterious Relic to Vestia Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Deliver the Mysterious Relic to Vestia Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: If you would be so kind as to deliver the relic to my wife Vestia, I would appreciate it. She's not only a fine priestess for our community, but she is one of the most well-versed scholars you'll find anywhere. I couldn't make heads or tails of this device even if there was a wager involved. My wife though, if anyone can figure out what this thing is, she could... and we need to know!
BShe's just around the bend, no doubt studying. Thanks, $n.
completion: Interesting... this came from the Ruins of Solarsal, you say? Well, Latro's right that I need to look at this. At first glance, it seems non-indigenous to the ruins. Then again, this isn't of naga design... not something as alien as this.
BIt is going to take some time to research this item. Once my research on it is done, maybe I will make use of your talents, should you be around.
BHere, take one of these extra items we have; I hope you'll find some use for it!

2943.name: Return to Troyas
desc: Deliver the book to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Deliver the book to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: Here it is, $N. Please, take care of my book.
BNow, hurry along. I'm sure Troyas is eager for your return.
completion: You have brought a book along. Excellent!

2967.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
desc: Speak with Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
details: You access the pedestal again; the platinum discs suddenly appear once more in your backpack.
BWith the knowledge of the stone watcher learned and the discs returned to your possession, the time has come to return to Thunder Bluff and inform the Nara Wildmane of your discovery.
completion: You were missing some discs? Interestingly enough, it seems that the discs of Norgannon are only parts of the complete set - like keys on a key ring, if you will.
BIf we can find the Plates of Uldum, then we could actually access the Uldum complex itself. I don't know whether to be excited by that prospect, or be terrified.
BWe may need to risk everything to ensure that those secrets the earth keeps which would destroy us all remain just that - secrets.

2991.name: Nekrum's Medallion
desc: Bring Nekrum's Medallion to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.
objectives: Bring Nekrum's Medallion to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.
details: I'll find out where your gryphon is, but first you have to do something for me. There's a troll in Zul'Farrak, Nekrum Gutchewer, who possesses a medallion I would very much like to study. Bring me that Medallion and I'll use my powers to find Sharpbeak.
BZul'Farrak is across the ocean to the west, in the desert of Tanaris.
completion: Ah, the medallion of Nekrum. It is rumored to have given the troll an unnatural long life, but at a cost. I hope to discover a way to reap the medallion's power while avoiding its... unpleasant side effects.
BYou have done me a service, $N. I shall now uphold my end of our bargain.

3063.name: Vengeance on the Northspring
desc: Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.
objectives: Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.
details: In my day, I was a seasoned hunter. There wasn't any creature around that I feared. Until...
BI was out in the forest, sharpening my blade after a tough battle, when I was ambushed. Harpies surrounded me, and I barely managed to drag myself to safety.
BEven now, I can still hear their cries echoing...
BI was never the same after that. But the hate boils inside of me -- I must get even, after all these years.
BThe Northspring harpies can be found to the west of here. $N, get my revenge.
completion: Thank you, $N. You have put an old tauren's mind at peace.

3087.name: Etched Parchment
desc: Read the Etched Parchment and speak to Jen'shan in the Valley of Trials.
objectives: Read the Etched Parchment and speak to Jen'shan in the Valley of Trials.
details: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $N.
BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the hunter trainer Jen'shan. She would have words with you when you're ready.
completion: When we finish speakin', you should talk to da rest of da citizens in da Valley. They ask you to do tings for them... tings that will test your skill and teach you some of da dangers of this land.
BAs you grow in experience and wisdom, you be needin' Jen'shan to show you better techniques and skills. Come back to Jen'shan often. I will let you know what I can teach you.

3375.name: Replacement Phial
desc: Bring a Mana Potion, Coal, and Sweet Nectar to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge to get a replacement for Talvash's Phial of Scrying.

3447.name: Secret of the Circle
desc: Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.
objectives: Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.
details: My memories are cloudy, but I will tell you what I can. The circle of statues in the Sunken Temple, while dangerous, I believe that they hold the secret to unlock an even greater treasure.
BFrom the main altar, I was able to activate a series of lights. I think that if you can uncover what these lights mean, you might be able to unlock whatever secrets are hiding in this room.
BI warn you though, $N. Great evil lies in the temple. It's likely that anything valuable will be fervently guarded...
completion: The eye of the idol glitters brightly even in the half-darkness of the temple. Its transparency reveals something shiny behind it. Sliding it to the side, you reach in and grasp what lies inside the statue.
BThe Atal'ai treasure is now yours.

3519.name: A Friend in Need
desc: Speak to Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen.
objectives: Speak to Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen.
details: Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.
BPlease tell Dirania Silvershine. She will be able to help me.
BHurry... I'm so dizzy...
completion: Oh dear; I was wondering why I hadn't seen Iverron yet today. And I've always warned him about those spiders...

3639.name: Show Your Work
desc: Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
details: As your mentor, I want samples of your work. You're a skilled engineer; there is no question of this, $N. What I hope to do though is analyze them for ways to emphasize goblin-oriented techniques in your future efforts. I need the following: twenty big iron bombs, twenty sticks of solid dynamite, and five explosive sheep - and keep the safeties armed!
BSubmit these items to me and I will issue you your own Goblin Engineer Membership Card; it is required for access to all goblin engineering trainers!
completion: Here is your first Goblin Engineer Membership Card!

BThis card has its dues paid for in advance for fourteen days; all cards expire after two weeks of activity. When it does, pay your next set of dues to any goblin engineer trainer in order to get another card; without the card, your membership will temporarily lapse and you cannot access new schemata.
BThis never affects what you already know; once a goblin engineer, always a goblin engineer.

3783.name: Are We There, Yeti?
desc: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.
objectives: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.
details: My friends are always coming up with great ideas. I've never felt like I could match them... until today! I just drew up the plans for something great! If you promise not to tell, I'll let you in on the secret...
BI'm going to make a mechanical yeti! Not only are my friends sure to be freaked out when they see it, but when they get over that, I know they'll be impressed!
BI need thick yeti fur from the ice thistle yeti to start with. Will you help? You'll find them to the southeast.
completion: These furs are perfect, $N. We're off to a great start here!

3903.name: Milly Osworth
desc: Speak with Milly Osworth.
objectives: Speak with Milly Osworth.
details: You've shown yourself a dependable $c, $N. Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?
BI have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble. She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable. I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
completion: Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me? He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.
BPerhaps you can help me?

4023.name: A Taste of Flame
desc: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.
You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.
objectives: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.
BYou have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.
details: You seek out the Flight? Present to me proof of your worth, mortal.
completion: <Cyrus examines the molt.>
BYou have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.

4143.name: Haze of Evil
desc: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze, then return to Muigin in Un'Goro Crater.
objectives: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze, then return to Muigin in Un'Goro Crater.
details: To tell you the truth, $N, I've never seen any plants like this in my travels. Perhaps I should take a trip to this crater...
BAt any rate, I think I know just the thing Muigin's looking for -- Atal'ai haze. It's horrid stuff, hard to collect, but it's just what he needs to control the little monsters.
BYou'll need to visit the temple of Atal'Hakkar in the Swamp of Sorrows. The Atal'ai Haze can be collected from the deep lurkers, murk worms, or oozes found there. Good luck, $N!
completion: I admit, I'm a bit hesitant to touch that stuff, $N! But if Gregan says it'll work, then I'm willing to give it a try!

4263.name: Incendius!
desc: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!
objectives: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!
details: Are you sure Pyron said 'Incendius' when he died?
B<Jalinda swallows hard.>
BLord Incendius is purported to be a minion of Ragnaros! Oh dear, oh dear... whatever will we do?
BDo you think you can handle another mission? I don't have anybody else to send, $N!
BWe will never get a team in if Incendius continues to raise Pyron from the ashes.
BYou'll have to find and destroy Lord Incendius!$B
completion: Oh dear! Are you sure Incendius said 'Ragnaros?'
B<Jalinda hands you something and pats you on the wrist as she fades deep into thought.>

4287.name: The Eastern Pylon
desc: Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
objectives: Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
details: During my stay here, I have heard strange rumors about mysterious pylons existing out in the wilderness of the crater, $N. I guess that they are quite large, with crystals lining their interiors.
BAlthough I've never seen one, I can't help but think that the rumors are true -- and that the pylons have something to do with all the crystals we found
BSo why don't you help me put my curiosity to rest? Supposedly, there is one in the eastern area of the crater. Do you think you can find it?
completion: Un'Goro is such a strange place, $N. When you enter the crater, it's as if you are in a completely different world...

4503.name: Shizzle's Flyer
desc: Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.
objectives: Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.
details: I'm making a flying machine!
BI got stranded here, and I'm absolutely horrible at finding my way around. I'd take a gryphon or wind rider back to Gadgetzan, but those beasts just scare me to death.

BSo, will you help me? All I have left to build is the wings, and I was thinking that the webby scales from the pterrordax and diemetradon would be perfect. There's no way I'm going to go up against one of those, but you look pretty tough. Why don't you give it a try?
completion: Yes, these scales are perfect. I should be able to get this flyer off the ground with these scales for sure!
BThanks!

4743.name: Seal of Ascension
desc: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.

It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!
objectives: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.

BIt is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!
details: Few of the black dragonkin, outside of those in the upper citadel, have the ability to forge the seal with their own flaming breath. Wyrmthalak is one such dragonkin, but his will is unbreakable.

BYou must travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. It is there that you will find an ancient drake known as Emberstrife. You must break his will, $N. Break it and use this orb on his weakened form. You will have scant seconds to control his mind and fan the flames that will forge the seal.
completion: Stand steady while I cast the final invocation of protection.
B<Vaelan's eyes turn to twin orbs of flame.>
BThe Seal of Ascension is complete...
BKnow this, I have imbued the artifact with some powerful protective wards. In your darkest hour, when all appears to be lost, the might of the red flight will be at your disposal.

4767.name: Wind Rider
desc: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.
objectives: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.
details: I've been tasked to recruit more wyverns for the master wind riders. Their numbers are growing and I myself hope to become a wind rider one day. However, we cannot train enough wyverns to keep up with the demand. Perhaps you can help me, $N.

BI need you to travel to Highperch to gather some wyvern eggs. From here, head northwest along the canyon walls to a ramp that will lead you into Highperch. Be careful, wyverns are very protective over their eggs and they will not be kind to intruders.
completion: Perfect! With these eggs I hope to take the next step to become a wind rider. Here is a token of my appreciation; may good hunting always shine upon you, $C.

4863.name: Enraged Wildkin
desc: Find Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked wagon.
objectives: Find Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked wagon.
details: Looking around, you don't see much that Jaron could want here. However, you do notice that the crate you found has been smashed open, almost as if this was what the wildkin were after...
BLooking to the east, you can barely make out an abandoned wagon. Perhaps you might find Jaron's things there. It's worth a look.
completion: Approaching the wagon, it doesn't appear that there is much more here for Jaron. But, looking on the ground, you notice some crates that look undamaged, despite being half-buried in the snow.

4983.name: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report
desc: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.
objectives: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.$B
details: Take this report back to Lexlort. It will redeem my good name and will surely give the K.E.F. a strategic advantage in dealing with these orcs.
BCome with you? I've got way too much work to do. Get going, they need these reports as soon as possible!$B
completion: I've got to hand it to her; she's managed to weasel her way out of another sticky situation! These reports will prove to be invaluable in our dealings with the Blackrock orcs.
BOf course, you will be rewarded for your hard work.

5055.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
desc: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.
objectives: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.
details: Swift, and clever, Brumeran glides silently across the snowy landscape of southern Winterspring. But do not let her graceful appearance convince you that she is harmless. All that cross her pay considerably, and often with their own lives.
BSeek out Brumeran of the chillwind among the chimera. Defeat her, then return again to me.
completion: Yes. You have returned. I believe now that you are a true $C by nature. You have faced the most ferocious of creatures and have returned, surpassing my expectations.
BYou are now ready for my final request.

5103.name: Hot Fiery Death
desc: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!
objectives: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!
details: The only thing that remains of this human are some charred bones. He seems to have died within arms reach of what he was after - unfired plate gauntlets.
BPerhaps you should grab the gauntlets and get out of the fire?
completion: What the...

5127.name: The Demon Forge
desc: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
BYou must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
BReturn both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.
details: Lorax makes deals, he does not accept them from insignificant mortals.

BA deal I shall make with you, however... take this pike, it is imbued with powerful Fel energies. When you find Goraluk Anvilcrack, slay him and drive this pike through his dying heart. His soul he bartered, his soul I shall have. Return the pike and return the breastplate that the thief stole and I shall teach you what it is that he was to learn.
completion: Our pact you did not break. The soul I did take. The reward I shall make.

5151.name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
desc: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.
objectives: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.
details: I am the only survivor from our caravan attack by the centaur! A rare yet mighty panther is guarding my best gizmo, which is around his neck. Hah! Even the centaur tremble in the presence of this ferocious beast!
BHere is the key to the cage. They took everything there, but left him alone. Slay this beast and bring back my hypercapacitor, and I shall reward you.
BThe wrecked caravan is just north of here.$B
completion: My hypercapacitor! This will keep me busy for a while until I can figure out what it does...

5223.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
desc: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
details: You delicately top off the empty bottle; a sample of the foul substance that churns under the platform of the cauldron now oozes back and forth inside the fragile glass container.
BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp to complete the mission.
completion: Another finely executed mission, $N! This makes three cauldrons available to us to turn against the Scourge. If Kel'Thuzad's necromantic dominance over these lands wasn't as strong as it currently is, I'd dare say you'd shut them down completely!

BAlchemist Arbington will have a report on what this cauldron - as well as the other cauldrons subverted - will require to deliver our counter agent to the plague. With that, the time has come to bring the last cauldron of the west under our influence!

5247.name: Fragments of the Past
desc: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
details: I will be able to help you, if recreating the artifact is truly what you wish to do.

BTo seal the pieces back together, I will need items with strong magical qualities. An enchanted thorium bar and five crystal restore... You'll also need to collect some water from what might seem an unlikely place... Find the dire pool along Eldreth Row at Dire Maul in Feralas, and fill this vial.
BWhile you are gone, I will attempt to glean from these pages the knowledge I need to repair the damage done to the relic.
completion: Using these elements, I can fuse the fragments together... to hopefully what they once were.

5343.name: Barov Family Fortune
desc: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.
objectives: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.
details: My dear brother Alexi. What a fool I was to spare his life. I looked into the face of the enemy, one of the undead, and let him live.
B<Weldon spits.>
