BHe now searches for MY inheritance. This simply cannot happen.
BFind my family's deeds before that vile retch gets his boney hands upon them and I shall reward you with vast riches. They lay in the ruins of the Scholomance. Make haste!
completion: Excellent work, $R. Now to secure my inheritance...

5463.name: Menethil's Gift
desc: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
objectives: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
details: I watched as the human, Ras Frostwhisper, pledged his undying soul to the Lich King. He drew the dagger to his own throat and with a smile, cut from ear to ear. His body collapsed inside the borders of the pentagram. The Lich King stood over the fallen mage and with a single motion, Ras Frostwhisper the lich, was born.
B<Leonid gazes at the ground and then looks up at you.>
BYes, $r, I remember. What you seek has a name - Menethil's Gift: The ground blessed by the Lich King - holy ground to Scourge.$B
completion: You place the keepsake on the tainted soil.

5511.name: The Key to Scholomance
completion: Well, here you are, $n - the completed Skeleton Key. I am certain as I can be that this key will allow you within the confines of the Scholomance. There's only one way to be absolutely sure it works, though. Waste no time in trying it out, I say.$b$bGood luck, mighty hero. May your victories continue to bring you fame and power as you lay waste to Scholomance!

5535.name: Spiritual Unrest
desc: Destroy 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings before returning to Loh'atu in Azshara.
objectives: Destroy 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings before returning to Loh'atu in Azshara.
details: Long ago, the Highborne were some of the most powerful students of the arcane the night elves ever produced. The corruption that comes along with such studies caused much harm to night elf society and greatly affected all of Azeroth... as I'm sure you well know.
BI promised the Sentinels that I would release the spirits from their mortal bonds as I find them. If you would do the same, then I am sure I can reward you some.
BThe spirits haunt the Shadowsong Shrine to the northeast of here.
completion: Well done, $C. Thank you for your help. The spirits are at peace, and the threats that their desire for the arcane draw have been lessened.
BI am sure that both sides of the conflict that ravishes Azeroth will see you are above such things.

5631.name: Returning Home
desc: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
details: A priestess recently visited our halls seeking you out, young $r. She said that she was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out a Priestess Alathea--she will tell you more.
BThe Light be with you, $N.
completion: Wonderful, you've returned home, $N. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.

5655.name: Hex of Weakness
desc: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
details: I sent here to make sure that you not wander too far from home, $N. They send me to make sure you return home because Ur'kyo, greatest of our priests, wish to speak to you. You go there. You go to the Valley of Spirits in the orc city and you speak to Ur'kyo. He wait for you now.
completion: You would do well to pay heed to this lesson, young one. The Hex of Weakness will be a great boon to you in battle. Later I will have tests for you to further yourself and prove your worth to the tribe.

5679.name: Devouring Plague
desc: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
objectives: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
details: Aelthalyste show our people great respect by sending them back to me for more training, and now I do the same for her tribe.
BYou return to the Undercity, $N. There, in the War Quarter, she be ready to teach you more 'bout your people and their ways. Go there, and do not wait long.
completion: I would teach you Devouring Plague if you feel you are prepared, $N. A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. Practice with it--there will be tests later.

5727.name: Hidden Enemies
desc: Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
details: Now let us see if this insignia you found is worth the effort.

BThere is a warlock within the city who believes he has my trust. He does not know that I realize where his true loyalties lie. He is in fact the leader of the Burning Blade. But do not rush off to do battle with him; he has a purpose, and we shall use him against our enemies.
BTake this insignia to him in the Cleft of Shadow here in Orgrimmar, speak to him and see if he believes you are one of his own, then return to me here.
completion: Excellent! Most excellent, $C!
BWhat you have done this day is only the first step in a much broader foundation--a foundation that we will build the destruction of the Shadow Council on, once and for all.
BTell me all he said... and leave not one word out--it may be more important than you realize.

5847.name: Welcome!
desc: Bring the Deathknell Gift Voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.
objectives: Bring the Deathknell Gift Voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.
details: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!

BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.
BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
completion: You are indeed a special hero, $N. We welcome you to the world of Azeroth, and offer you one of these unique gifts!

5943.name: Gizelton Caravan
desc: Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.
objectives: Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.
details: You look like a capable $r. Perhaps you're looking to make some money? Cork and I started this caravan to make a bundle of money; little did we know the dangers of turning a buck!

BUp ahead is Mannoroc Coven... normally the demons ignore us but something has the kodos spooked this time. I'll pay you to protect the caravan past Mannoroc Coven. Once we are safely past you can receive your reward from our business associate Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp.
completion: Not sure it's a prosperous proposition to be paying so much money to protect the Gizelton Caravan. Cork and Rigger only make one gold piece a week, but as long as they keep paying for my kodos I can care less how they run their business.

6063.name: Taming the Beast
desc: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Webwood Lurker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Webwood Lurker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
details: As a hunter, it is important to remember the responsibility you hold in your hands. Nature is not a power that can be bent to obey our desires; it is one that is to be respected and acknowledged as something stronger than your very existence.
B$N, you must prove your understanding of this before you will gain the ability to tame an animal to be your companion.
BYour first task is to take this taming rod. With it, you will be able to tame a webwood lurker. Tame it, and practice your skills as a hunter.
completion: Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner.

6087.name: Taming the Beast
desc: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Prairie Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Prairie Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
details: You have a fiery spirit, hunter, readily awaiting your next challenge.
BYour next task is to gain the companionship of a wolf known as the prairie stalker. This creature is swift and fearless; in taking this beast as your pet, you must also take on these qualities.
BDuring a battle, you will learn how you and your pet will become a team. In the end you must work as one, muscle to muscle.
BHere is the taming rod, $N. Tame a prairie stalker and practice your skills.
completion: Yes... The Earthmother believes that you are ready for the next lesson.

6135.name: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
desc: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.
It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.
objectives: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.
BIt is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.
details: Up until now, you have completed the missions I have assigned; even if not in the most timely manner.
BI suppose you think that you are ready for a challenge. Yes... Yes, imbecile, perhaps you are ready for a more involved set of missions.
BThe albino demon bat, Duskwing, roams the countryside just north of here. Track him down and destroy him. Return to me with a patch of his white fur and you shall be rewarded.$B
completion: Excellent work, imbecile. I shall fashion this fur into something you can use.
B

6183.name: Honor the Dead
desc: Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.
objectives: Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.
details: Five of my best field agents were assigned the Marris case. One returned, only to end up dead in his sleep three days later.
BWhat little information we did manage to get out of him was incoherent gibberish. We made out two words: "Nathanos", and "Blightcaller."

BI do not have the available manpower to continue this investigation and Ravenholdt will not assist us. We must get to the bottom of this; if only to provide closure to the families of the deceased. Will you help?
completion: <Mathias nods.>
BI had faith that Bolvar would send me men and women of honor - the most dedicated soldiers of the Alliance.

6543.name: The Warsong Reports
desc: Open the Bundle of Reports. Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.
objectives: Open the Bundle of Reports. Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.
details: I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.

BYour first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. You will find a scout and an outrider there.
BGive them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.
completion: I can see that you are one that can be counted on. These updates are crucial to our plans to further our presence in Ashenvale. We can now plan our next move.

6567.name: The Champion of the Horde
desc: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.
objectives: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.
details: I have received word from one of my champions that a way into the lair of the dragon may exist. You are to seek him out.
BRexxar wanders the desert wasteland of Desolace, traveling between Stonetalon and Feralas. He awaits your arrival.
completion: There is but one way into the dragon's lair, $R.

BYou see, only the strongest of the Black Dragonflight are allowed entry into the lair of the brood mother. Many trials must be passed and the key to enter ceremoniously enchanted by General Drakkisath himself!
BSince you are not of black dragonkin, you may have some difficulty in obtaining passage.
B<Rexxar grins.>

7023.name: Greatfather Winter is Here!
desc: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.
details: Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend! Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter, who's currently in Ironforge! If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil. Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year!

BAlso, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year. We have a great selection to choose from. Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
completion: Ho ho hello. I am Greatfather Winter, and I - courtesy of the fine folks of Smokywood Pastures... "Fresh from our farm to your plate, it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness" - would like to wish you a fantastic Feast of Winter Veil.
BIf you've been good this year, maybe you will receive treats from Smokywood Pastures as your treat for the Feast of Winter Veil. Huzzah.

7167.name: The Eye of Command
details: Drek'Thar sings your praises. Kalimdor is abuzz with tales of your heroics. The Warchief glows - your stalwart defense of our clan has pleased him greatly.
BYou have earned the Eye of Command.
BPresent your insignia, Commander $N.
B<Warmaster Laggrond salutes>
completion: Channel the power of the insignia. Let the enemy hear your words. The might of the Horde is unquestionable!

7383.name: Crown of the Earth
desc: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
objectives: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
details: All was not well with Teldrassil, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on Teldrassil may be attributed.

BHowever, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
completion: To be in the presence of the Oracle Tree... it is almost to feel wisdom take form. Let me continue the telling...

BWith Teldrassil grown, the Arch Druid approached the dragons for their blessings, as the dragons had placed upon Nordrassil in ancient times. But Nozdormu, Lord of Time, refused to give his blessing, chiding the druid for his arrogance. In agreement with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza also refused Staghelm, and without her blessing, Teldrassil's growth has been flawed and unpredictable...

7503.name: The Greatest Race of Hunters
desc: Return the book to its rightful owners.
objectives: Return the book to its rightful owners.
details: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
completion: Excellent work, $R. Should you find any more tomes, do not hesitate to return them to us.
BAs time passes, we tend to change around and even add new rewards for the return of missing tomes.

7623.name: Lord Banehollow
desc: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.
objectives: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
BUse the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.
details: Mor'zul says that you want to open a portal to Xoroth. To do that, you'll need Xorothian stardust. That's not easy to find on Azeroth!
BThere is one being who might have some: Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar, the seat of the Shadow Council! Speak with him and he might part with the stardust.
BBut if you're going to Jaedenar, then you'll need to cloak yourself in the Shadow Council's own flavor of evil. That will require some of my shadowy potions, and that will cost you...
completion: My patience spans the millenia, warlock. But do not think that allows you more than an instant of my time...

7647.name: Judgment and Redemption
desc: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.
Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.
objectives: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.
BGive the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.
details: Take this satchel - in it are the items you will need for your task.

BUse the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to bring forth accursed spirits that must be judged. Use your judgments wisely during this trial - they will prove more potent than you realize. After the spirits, the death knight will appear; defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the charger. Only then $N, will you be able to redeem it and place your barding upon your new steed!
BGood luck!
completion: A glimmer of life - long vacant from the poor beast - shines in its eyes as you hand its judged soul back to it. You feel a holy rush of power surge around you as you place the barding on its back, having judged the charger redeemed. The charger nuzzles your hand as the burdens of the past are lifted from the beast. You now feel as though you could call upon this beast to serve as your steed, should the need arise.
BYou have claimed your epic charger, $C! Congratulations!

7791.name: A Donation of Wool
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7815.name: Snapjaws, Mon!
desc: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.
objectives: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.
details: Don't let their big eyes fool you, mon! Those saltwater snapjaws be a menace. I can't fish for five minutes without getting a broken line from one of those oversized fish vacuums stealing my bait.
BDo me and the people of Revantusk Village a service and kill em, mon.
BKill the whole lot of em!
completion: Oh, mon! I can't thank you enough! Hopefully this here fishing pole will be reward enough for the job.

7839.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
desc: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.
You recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.
objectives: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.
BYou recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.
details: Vilebranch scum invaded our village and stole my tools! I have backup tools but the set they stole was a gift given to me by a kind hearted gnome that saved my life when I was a young orc.
BI want those tools back, $N - they mean the world to me.
BMarkhor reported that the tools were spotted near the Agol'watha and Shaol'watha temples.
BThose temples are in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands.
BRecover my tools!
completion: My tools! You found them! Oh glorious day! Thank you, $N.

7863.name: Sentinel Basic Care Package
completion: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, $N. As a reward, please take this care package! Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Warsong Gulch.

BAs you continue to prove yourself inside the Gulch, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. Rations become available when you are Friendly with us, and bandages when you are Honored.

7887.name: Talismans of Merit
desc: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.

8055.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Breastplate
desc: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Tabard. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Tabard. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: Battle gear gives you power in the tribe. The freethinkers are honored in this way. They are zealots. They imbue their breastplates with powerful mojo. If their beliefs falter in the face of the enemy, their breastplate will not.

BYou must be revered amongst us to possess such a breastplate. Go to Zul'Gurub. Take the Paragons of Power I need. Take the Paragons most painfully from the fools inside. Bring them to me. Prove your worth as a freethinker once and for all.
completion: You have done what few ever could. You have brought the minions of Hakkar to their knees. You have shown them what a freethinker can do. You have shown us how a heretic could be revered in the tribe. You have more than real power. You ARE real power.
BTake the breastplate, freethinker. Crush those who oppose you.

8079.name: Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Breastplate
desc: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Kossack. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Kossack. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: The vindicator's symbol of power is the breastplate. It is forged with powerful mojo. It is trusted only to those we revere. It is the Zandalar symbol of vengeance.

BTo become a vindicator is to become vengeance. Take the Paragons of Power we need from Zul'Gurub. Bring them to us. We will take the mojo stolen from us. We will make the minions of Hakkar pay. We will reward you with the vindicator's breastplate.
BGo. Be our vengeance, $N.
completion: You are to be revered for your deeds. The tribe rewards its heroes. Zul'Gurub has tasted Zandalar vengeance like never before.
BYour deeds will herald the deeds of others to come. They will look upon you as a sign of real power. They will look upon you as vengeance personified!

8103.name: The Pebble of Kajaro
completion: Continue in your decimation of the trolls of Zul'Gurub. Hakkar must see that the world will not buckle beneath his indomitable will.

8151.name: The Hunter's Charm
desc: Speak to Ogtinc in Azshara.
objectives: Speak to Ogtinc in Azshara.
details: Ogtinc of Azshara has sent out a call for seasoned hunters such as yourself. He is a furbolg hunter who has left his tribe to aid the Cenarion Circle. His teachings are meant to enrich the wisdom of others who share his craft, and guide them toward maintaining a balance. You would do well to speak with him.
BOgtinc resides atop the cliffs of Azshara, northeast from the Ruins of Eldarath.
completion: It is no longer my purpose to hunt, but to teach the $C. That is what fate has handed to me.
BCraft with me a $C's charm -- a collection of trophies from fallen prey that will remind you of your past trials and triumphs. In the end I will keep the charm, but reward you with something else.

8271.name: Hero of the Stormpike
completion: NULL

8295.name: Quell the Silverwing Usurpers
desc: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.
objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.
details: The wilds of the Ashenvale forest will succumb to the might of the Horde, $r. Nothing the Silverwing say or do can stop our sovereign imperative. Kalimdor belongs to the Horde. How dare they attempt to prevent us from harvesting what is rightfully ours!

BLet the pride swell in your chest as you cut down their weak attempts at slowing our progress. Destroy the Silverwing Sentinels, and earn a Warsong mark of honor. Return to me with such a mark, $N, and you will be rewarded.
completion: NULL

8343.name: Goldleaf's Discovery
desc: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
objectives: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
details: $N, Aurel Goldleaf thinks she's found a way to summon and defeat a ruling member of the Abyssal Council! Such a task will be dangerous, but you have earned great respect amongst the Cenarion Circle. We know that if anyone can do it, you can.
BMay fortune go with you, $N. Speak with Aurel when you are ready.
completion: What Huum says is true. I believe I know how to summon a lord of the Abyssal Council! Listen on, and I will explain...

8367.name: For Great Honor
desc: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
details: Serving the Horde in one of the great battles against the Alliance is a source of great honor! The few however, that have served the Horde in ALL of our active battlefronts are our truly great fighters. We shall vanquish our opponents, not by fighting isolated skirmishes, but by waging a well-coordinated war.
BGo forth and crush the Alliance in Arathi Basin, Alterac Valley, Eye of the Storm and Warsong Gulch! For Honor! For the Horde!
completion: Your trials have not been easy, but your courage did not escape you and your strength did not fail. Part with past tokens of victory, $C. None shall need them as a reminder of your worth. Stand up straight, $N. Today you will walk with great pride for you are a hero!

8391.name: Claiming Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

8415.name: Chillwind Point
desc: Speak to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp.
objectives: Speak to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp.
details: Commander Ashlam Valorfist has sent out a call for a paladin of your purity and valor, $n. You can find him at Chillwind Camp in the southern part of the Western Plaguelands. Seek him and aid in his cause for the Light!
completion: Very well, $C! Let's see what you're made of.

8439.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
details: Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war. No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.

BThe battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple. Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going. Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, $N!
completion: Securing our resources in Arathi is an important task! You've done well, $N.

8511.name: The Alliance Needs Light Leather!
desc: Bring 10 Light Leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 10 Light Leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
details: We Stoneflayers have a long history of being skinners, $c. That's why the Alliance has asked my family to help out with the collection of light leather for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. I'm here to see to it that the leather is tanned correctly for whatever they want to put it to use for. But we need your help.
BSince I have to be here doing that, I need you to go out and collect the skins, returning them to me here. What do you say, $g lad : lass;, will you give it a go?
completion: I dare say the Alliance is going to be very happy with your skins here, $C. I'll make sure that not a one goes to waste. Thank you, and make sure that you check back in with me once I've counted them up to see if we need more.

8535.name: Hoary Templar
desc: Summon and slay a Hoary Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.

8559.name: Conqueror's Greaves
desc: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of War, 5 Ivory Scarabs and 5 Gold Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj. This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.

8583.name: The Horde Needs More Purple Lotus!
desc: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Apothecary Jezel at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

8607.name: The Horde Needs Mageweave Bandages!
desc: Bring 20 Mageweave Bandages to Lady Callow at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 20 Mageweave Bandages to Lady Callow at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: I trust that you are speaking to me because you are going to help with the collection I have been entrusted to? Good! By whatever means, and I do mean whatever, I wish for you to gather up a good number of mageweave bandages. Fresh would be nice, but not absolutely necessary. Return them to me here, $c, and I will personally see to it that you are properly rewarded.
completion: Surprising, yet acceptable. Perhaps I underestimated your 'abilities', $C. Perhaps. You completed a very simple task, and for doing so you are to be rewarded out of proportion. But don't let it go to your head. If you really want to prove yourself you should get out there and bring me another bundle of mageweave bandages.

8631.name: Enigma Leggings
desc: Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8655.name: Avenger's Greaves
desc: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj. This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.

8679.name: Grimtotem the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8703.name: Ring of Eternal Justice
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Vermillion Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Vermillion Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.
BThe gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.
BBring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, $c.
completion: I will swap the gem on the ring for you. You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.

8727.name: Farwhisper the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8751.name: The Protector of Kalimdor

objectives.target: Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight

completion: Rise, Protector of Kalimdor! Rise and be recognized!

8775.name: Target: Hive'Regal Spitfires
desc: Kill 30 Hive'Regal Spitfires and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.

8799.name: The Hero of the Day
desc: Bring 1 Deeprock Salt and 5 gold coins to the Holly Preserver machine, upon which you will receive 5 Preserved Holly.
objectives: Bring 1 Deeprock Salt and 5 gold coins to the Holly Preserver machine, upon which you will receive 5 Preserved Holly.
details: Listen... I'm not really supposed to be telling you this, but since you're the hero of the day and all...

BThere's fresh holly everywhere this time of the year, but it never lasts. We've got a machine that preserves holly - it never goes bad! We use it to spice up the holiday... and profits during the summer!
BI'll let you use the preserver, but only if you're a master cook. You'll need some deeprock salt and two, three, oh let's say five gold. It'll net you a nice batch that's yours to keep.
completion: The machine lets off a little rumble and a small amount of steam as it starts working. It is not too long thereafter until it stops, heralded by another small jet of steam erupting from it. A door hatch opens, revealing a batch of preserved holly!

8871.name: The Lunar Festival
desc: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Park District in Stormwind. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
objectives: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Park District in Stormwind. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
details: It's that time of the year, $N! The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival. You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight. She can tell you more about the holiday.
completion: Welcome, $N. Are you here to join in the festivities?

8919.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Dreadmist Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Dreadmist Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
details: Hail, $c! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.
BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.
BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
completion: Ah, yes. Mux will be quite happy with this.
BThose bracers were part of a larger armor set. If you're interested in providing me with further assistance, I'd be willing to consider parting with the rest of it.

8943.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.$B
details: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $N. As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.
BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
completion: Our agreement remains in place. Just remember, this is but a taste of what awaits you. Free me of this cursed fate and I will reward you with items of truly great power.

8967.name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
desc: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
objectives: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
details: It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire Maul. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.
BShe didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
completion: Thank you, $N, for putting Isalien's spirit to rest. Now, perhaps, she will find peace with her goddess. But, there is still a great deal of work ahead of us if we are to get out of this fine pickle we find ourselves in.

BUnfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.

8991.name: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
desc: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
objectives: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
details: The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, decided to join the Scarlet Crusade upon the disbanding of our mercenary company. They took the right piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet with them. Good riddance, I say, but we need that piece back.
BFrom what we could gather, they were actually slain by Grand Crusader Dathrohan himself for failing the initiation rites inside his chamber in the Scarlet Bastion.
BIn any case, we... meaning you, are still going to need to retrieve that piece of the amulet.
completion: I suppose it's for the best that the souls of those two have finally been put to rest, even if I didn't like them while they were alive. In any case, we have what we were after, and now the amulet is reassembled! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.
BIn order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

9015.name: The Challenge
desc: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone. Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands with the first piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet.
objectives: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone. Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands with the first piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet.
details: Heed me well, $N. For the banner to work in the desired way, you will need to step into the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths. Allow yourself to be sentenced by High Justice Grimstone and place the banner firmly on the ground in a sign of defiance.
BYour victim will not be able to restrain himself and shall enter the fray filled with a desire to fight you. Once you obtain that which you seek, go back to Anthion.
completion: You've recovered part of the medallion, $N?

9039.name: Dreadnaught Sabatons
desc: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Sabatons if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Sabatons, 12 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

9063.name: Torwa Pathfinder
desc: Speak with Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
objectives: Speak with Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
details: A hunter by the name of Torwa Pathfinder has requested the help of a druid. He said only we would possess the necessary skills and respect for nature to help him.
BThere is a road that connects the Un'Goro Crater and the desert of Tanaris. As that road enters the crater, you will find Torwa close by.
completion: You have traveled far to meet with me, $C, and not a moment too soon.

9087.name: Dreamwalker Legguards
desc: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreamwalker Legguards if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Legguards, 20 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 8 Cured Rugged Hides and 1 Nexus Crystal.

9111.name: Robe of Faith
desc: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Robe of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Robe, 25 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals.

9183.name: Craftsman's Writ - Radiant Circlet
desc: Deliver 3 Radiant Circlets and the Craftsman's Writ - Radiant Circlet - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

objectives: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.
*Blood-Stained Letter (provided)
Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
* Cirrusfly Queen slain
details: If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.
Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.
Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.

objectives: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
*Remote Detonator Kit (provided)
details: You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.
If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator - it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.
Oh - and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.

objectives: Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
*Arcane Mote (provided)
details: You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?
Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.

objectives: Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
* Titan Relic (Forever) (Provided)
details: Truly, this is a fascinating object.
It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.

While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.
You can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
